gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 diagnoses incomplete unchecked-pair bookkeeping after inserting an L-chain, not the distinct failure to ensure that inserted supports and induced parent supports satisfy the nested refinement-domain containment requirement. Its mention of enlargement of Omega and fill-in functions does not recognize that the domain itself can cease to be an admissible nested support union or require parent closure.

ISSUE-004 explicitly identifies the uninitialized unchecked_funcs state, the resulting failure to form the complete next candidate-pair set, and the omission of new corners or fill-in functions paired with pre-existing unresolved functions. Its proposed repair returns and maintains the function set and forms pairs against all unresolved functions, directly addressing the full gold defect.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries identify the exact executable-state and candidate-generation failure: the main loop does not retain the complete unresolved-function set, so the next unchecked-pair set is undefined or incomplete and cannot certify that all newly possible problematic pairs were examined.

component_coverage.gold_component: After new corners or functions enter the unresolved set, pairs with existing unresolved functions and among the new functions must be examined for termination to certify the absence of problematic pairs.

It does not recognize the distinct geometric defect that directly unioning marked elements can make Omega fail to be a union of closed zero-form supports, nor the need for support closure to preserve the refinement-domain assumption.

Both prescribe unconstrained open-knot spaces for the natural-boundary numerical test.
